description: This file defines functions and types for generating, manipulating, and comparing ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) node snapshots, including rendering ARIA trees, matching templates, and detecting changes. It is part of a larger accessibility testing or snapshot system.

classes.name: AriaSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the ARIA tree, including root node, element mappings, references, and iframe references.

methods.name: generateAriaTree
methods.description: Generates an ARIA snapshot tree from a root element based on specified options.

methods.name: matchesExpectAriaTemplate
methods.description: Matches a given ARIA template against the ARIA tree of a root element, returning matched nodes and received data.

methods.name: getAllElementsMatchingExpectAriaTemplate
methods.description: Returns all elements matching a given ARIA template within a root element.

methods.name: renderAriaTree
methods.description: Renders an ARIA snapshot as a YAML-like string, optionally comparing with a previous snapshot for diffs.

methods.name: findNewElement
methods.description: Finds the corresponding DOM element for a new ARIA node compared to a previous ARIA node.
